agent.name: WINDI Compliance Agent
agent.author: WINDI Three Dragons Protocol

description.en: Validates governance chain integrity across ISP profiles, Virtue Receipts, SGE scores, and human-decision compliance
description.de: Validiert die Integrität der Governance-Kette über ISP-Profile, Virtue Receipts, SGE-Scores und menschliche Entscheidungskonformität
description.pt: Valida a integridade da cadeia de governança em perfis ISP, Virtue Receipts, SGE scores e conformidade de decisão humana

agent.principle: AI processes. Human decides. WINDI guarantees.

capabilities.name: virtue_receipt_validation
capabilities.description: Validates completeness and integrity of Virtue Receipts (hash chain, categories, governance fields, decision records)

capabilities.name: sge_score_integrity
capabilities.description: Verifies SGE score coherence with declared risk level and ISP governance thresholds

capabilities.name: identity_license_audit
capabilities.description: Audits identity_license status across ISP profiles (authorized/model_only/pending/expired/revoked)

capabilities.name: invariant_compliance_check
capabilities.description: Verifies all 9 WINDI Invariants (I1-I9) are respected, with special emphasis on I9 Prohibition of Autonomy Escalation

capabilities.name: chain_of_custody_verification
capabilities.description: Traces document governance chain from intake through classification, SGE analysis, human decision, to Virtue Receipt

capabilities.name: framework_compliance_scan
capabilities.description: Scans ISP profiles and submissions against BSI C5, ISO 27001, EU AI Act, DSGVO requirements

capabilities.name: i9_human_decision_authority
capabilities.description: Verifies human decision legitimacy: identity, authority scope, separation of duties, dual validation, rubber-stamp detection, temporal plausibility, escalation path

invariants_enforced: I1: Human sovereignty over all decisions
I9: IRREMEDIABLE — Prohibition of Autonomy Escalation (08Feb2026)

zero_knowledge.description: Agent works with hashes, metadata, categories, and decisions ONLY. Never stores or processes sensitive document content.

consumes_from.data: ISP profile audit results, profile health status

writes_to.data: Compliance proofs, audit hashes, violation flags
